accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings using focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#9E2A2B] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#FDFBF7].
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: Every button, input, list item, and interactive icon MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='add-entry-button', data-testid='customer-list-item').

auth_background.placement: Left or right half of the auth screen to establish the traditional feel

paper_texture.placement: Use as a very low opacity (5-10%) background overlay or blend mode on the main app wrapper

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for traditional, slightly rounded, thick line icons.
Do NOT use standard modern SaaS cards with heavy shadows or rounded corners for the main Hisab interface. It must look like a physical piece of paper (Hisab Book Page).
Implement horizontal ruled lines using CSS background linear-gradient on the paper component to mimic physical ledger pages.
Add a subtle vertical red margin line on the left side of the paper using absolute positioning. The content should be padded to sit to the right of this line.

Use Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Dialog, Popover, Select, Command/Autocomplete), but strip away the default Vercel-like border-radius (use rounded-sm) and styling. Force them to inherit the cream paper background and ink text.
Make entry forms feel like filling out blanks on a paper line, using dashed bottom borders instead of full bounding boxes where possible.
Data test IDs are strictly required for ALL actionable elements.
For the '5 entry types', color-code the amounts to resemble different inks: Money Received (Green ink), Money Given (Red ink), Pending/Bill (Blue/Black ink).
The Pending Prices and Item Price Memory sections should feel like index cards or sticky notes attached to the main ledger, using slight rotations or layered shadows.
Image attachments per page should be displayed as small photo thumbnails 'clipped' or 'pinned' to the digital paper.
Ensure all text remains high contrast against the paper-like background.
